stops.message: the journalist-query mailbox at imap.gmail.com refused the credential in SOS_IMAP_USER/SOS_IMAP_PASSWORD ([AUTHENTICATIONFAILED] Invalid credentials (Failure)). The secrets are SET -- this is not 'not configured yet', it is a working mailbox connection that has stopped working. No digests were read, so no queries could be surfaced and none can be said to have been missed or not missed.
stops.unblock: Rotate SOS_IMAP_PASSWORD (repository secret) for mailbox s*********@gmail.com and re-run. A Google app password is revoked whenever the account password changes, which is the most likely cause; only the account owner can mint a new one. Nothing in this repository can restore authentication, and nothing here will pretend the lane is reading mail while it is not.
